title: Chapter 4: Strangeness In The Night
content:
Chapter 4: Strangeness In The Night

A great battle started again. Facing the fierce attack of the puppies, the green knights joined the battle. They cooperated with the big lizards and had strong combat power, which was more than enough to deal with the siege of two puppies.

However, facing Wu Qing's worm sea tactics, their individual combat power advantage could not change the outcome.

Two puppies in a group continued to join the battlefield. The green knights felt that they could not kill all the puppies in front of them. The more they killed, the more puppies there were.

In the end, they all fell under the blades and sharp teeth of the puppies.

Wu Qing appeared on the battlefield and smiled with satisfaction at the remaining dozen puppies.

This was a brilliant victory!

Behind him, the puppies were still rushing over.

Through the vision of the sent puppies, Wu Qing found that after this battle, the number of green people chasing him in the forest had greatly decreased, and they were scattered.

Wu Qing transferred the injured puppies back to the base for recuperation, and the other puppies were dispersed into the forest to scout the enemy and expand the map vision.

The greenskins suffered heavy losses in the pursuit of Wu Qing. They either chose to gather stronger forces to continue the pursuit, or they would give up because of the great loss of strength.

No matter how the greenskins act, Wu Qing will take the initiative on the battlefield from now on.

The sky gradually darkened, and before he knew it, it was dusk.

Through the puppy's sight, Wu Qing found that the greenskins in the forest began to withdraw from the forest in an orderly manner.

"Give up? Well, wait until tomorrow, you will have even less chance."

After a day of constant tossing and turning, Wu Qing was really tired. He returned to the Zerg base with ease. A mother nest had evolved a room inside according to his requirements.

Wu Qing entered the room inside the mother nest. Except that all the items were made of organic matter, he was very satisfied with everything else.

Lying on the bed in the room, the mother nest transmitted energy through organic matter. Wu Qing felt a heat flow in his body, which was very comfortable. His injuries and fatigue were recovering rapidly.

The energy and water needed by the body were also replenished.

Wu Qing switched to the view of the puppy that was following the retreat of the greenskins. He saw that the greenskins outside the forest had already built a camp. Upon closer observation, he could find that a mysterious force was shrouding the entire camp.

The greenskins who went out returned to the camp in groups, as if they were being chased by something.

Wu Qing also noticed something strange.

No matter what the problem was, he was prepared to remain unchanged and develop the Zerg base first.

Wu Qing stopped hatching the puppies. At this time, the system resources still had energy: 1685, and gas 665.

After counting the number of puppies, there were still 29, one host and one worker bee.

Wu Qing began to hatch the worker bees. After the worker bees were hatched, they built an evolution chamber in the territory.

This building can not only upgrade the offensive and defensive capabilities of the Zerg ground forces, but also is the prerequisite building for the construction of the Zerg's important defensive building, the air defense tower.

After the construction of the evolution chamber was completed, Wu Qing dispatched another worker bee to build a colony at a suitable location, and the colony then chose to evolve into an air defense tower with anti-stealth and air defense capabilities.

Wu Qing continuously hatched worker bees and went to mine, which was a stable source of system resources.

When the population reached the upper limit, a host was hatched.

During this period, Wu Qing also built two defensive spikes and two anti-aircraft towers. The territory had three ground defenses and three air defenses, forming a triangle, which was enough to protect the safety of the entire Zerg territory.

With enough defensive buildings, Wu Qing's heart was finally at ease.

Wu Qing left the nest and looked at the completely dark forest. The fog slowly rose. From the perspective of the puppy outside, he felt that the whole forest was shrouded in a weird atmosphere.

This feeling is indescribable and makes people very uncomfortable.

Wu Qing discovered through the collective consciousness of the Zerg that every puppy outside the Zerg base has been entangled with a faint spiritual energy since nightfall, trying to affect their spirits.

Fortunately, the puppy is not a single individual, but a part of the collective consciousness of the Zerg. It is almost impossible to interfere with the puppy controlled by the powerful collective consciousness of the Zerg through spiritual power.

After discovering the abnormality, Wu Qing ordered all the puppies to return to the base immediately.

Through the puppies' experience on the way back, Wu Qing saw that the various animals in the forest were not affected and were still moving normally.

Suddenly, a puppy that was running back in the forest lost contact. Wu Qing retrieved the last information that the lost puppy sent to the collective consciousness. The sensitive puppy only saw a black shadow and was hit hard and lost contact.

Wu Qing did not let the other puppies check, but asked them to return with all their strength.

While waiting for the puppies to return, Wu Qing upgraded the excavation through the mother nest, allowing the Zerg to have the ability to drill into the ground.

He also upgraded the melee attack and carapace of the Zerg's ground part through the evolution chamber, and upgraded the metabolic enhancement and adrenal glands through the hatching nest.

These upgrades have brought the puppies' combat effectiveness to the current limit. If they fight in the daytime in this state, the puppies' losses will be much smaller.

The cost of the upgrade is not small, consuming a total of 650 energy points and 650 gas points. There is no income for the gas for the time being, and only 15 points are left.

In the end, except for one puppy that lost contact, the other 28 puppies all returned safely to the Zerg territory.

As soon as the puppies returned to the Zerg territory, the spiritual power that entangled them suddenly appeared. One by one, black and strange things like octopuses crawled on their heads, twisting constantly, and the scene was a bit frightening.

These strange things came to the home of the Zerg collective consciousness, and they immediately felt bad and wanted to leave, but it was too late.

A powerful mental storm swept through, sweeping them into dots of black mist.

The causal relationship is established, whether to convert matter into energy? Yes/No

Wu Qing of course chose yes. The black mist disappeared, and the system resources, energy and qi were constantly increasing. The resources consumed in the upgrade were replenished from here. This was really a pleasant surprise.

"No wonder those green-skinned people run so fast. This kind of weird thing is really impossible for ordinary people to deal with!"

"Fortunately, the mental strength of the Zerg collective consciousness is strong enough. As the number of Zerg units increases, this consciousness will become stronger and stronger. Weird things like this kind of mind control will have no effect on the Zerg."

After solving a crisis, Wu Qing did not dare to relax. He knew too little about this world. Only by constantly developing and growing can he reduce his anxiety.

With the resources just now coming in, he immediately built a hydralisk cave that required gas resources and prepared to produce hydralisks that could attack from a distance and against the air.

All the puppies burrowed into the ground to rest, and only the worker bees were busy in the entire Zerg territory.

As more and more buildings were built, the organic spread representing the Zerg territory continued to expand at an ever-increasing speed, covering a large area at the bottom of the valley.

The Zerg itself is a very terrifying and weird existence, and the surrounding animals dare not approach this area.

The group of worker bees continued to grow, and the system's energy resources finally had a stable source, and the number of hosts also increased to 6.

Knowing the benefits of the strong collective consciousness of the Zerg, Wu Qing kept increasing the population.

When the number of worker bees remained at around 20, Wu Qing stopped increasing the population. These worker bees had already dug several holes in the Zerg territory and went deep into the mountains to collect mineral resources.

The current energy resources can be kept stable and sufficient for the time being.

The figure of the Hydralisk more than three meters tall appeared in front of Wu Qing. This long-range combat unit that can attack both the ground and the air is a versatile and backbone force in the Zerg ground forces.

The only drawback is that it requires 25 points of gas resources to hatch. At this stage, there are not many sources of gas, and it cannot be hatched in large quantities.

When the night was deep and the tenth Hydralisk was born, a creepy laugh came from outside the Zerg territory.

"Hehehe...!"

Along with the erratic laughter, the valley outside the Zerg territory was full of dark shadows, as if something terrible was about to appear.

"Here comes the big guy!"

Wu Qing immediately mobilized the worker bees that were mining, consumed the accumulated energy, and built a mother nest and four reproductive bodies.

"You are such a ghost! I want to see what you are made of!"
